paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The evolution of KV caches in the streaming setting.
model_annotation: The figure consists of two line plots, sharing the same x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with the variable "m", has a linear scale, a value range from approximately 0 to a value greater than $m_0$, and no units are present. The top plot illustrates the evolution of a variable denoted as "n" over "m", with the y-axis labeled as "n", a linear scale, a value range from 0 to approximately $c - a$, and no units are present; tick labels are not provided but appear to be regularly spaced. A single black line with a solid style and no markers is plotted, starting at approximately $(0, c - a)$ and ending at a point greater than $(m_0, w)$. The line exhibits a repeating pattern of sharp declines and increases, with notable points at approximately $(m_0, w)$. The bottom plot shows the evolution of "Size$_{run}$" over "m", with the y-axis labeled as "Size$_{run}$", a linear scale, a value range from 0 to approximately $c$, and no units are present; tick labels are not provided but appear to be regularly spaced. A single black line with a solid style and no markers is plotted, starting at approximately $(0, a)$ and ending at a point greater than $(m_0, w + a + s)$. This line also displays a repeating pattern of sharp declines and increases, with notable points at approximately $(m_0, w + a + s)$.
